description: This file contains a static utility class 'RuntimeTypeNameParser' for parsing type names formatted by 'RuntimeTypeNameFormatter'. It includes methods for parsing complex type specifications, handling generics, arrays, nested types, and assembly qualifiers, along with internal helper classes and constants.

classes.name: RuntimeTypeNameParser
classes.description: A static class providing methods to parse type names into type specifications, supporting complex type syntax including generics, arrays, nested types, and assembly qualifiers.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Public method to parse a string or ReadOnlySpan<char> representing a type name into a TypeSpec object.

methods.name: ParseInternal
methods.description: Internal recursive method that performs the core parsing logic, handling tuples, named types, generics, and modifiers.
